pages.title: The Arcanist
pages.text: You are not the only one who has heard the hum in the stone.$(br2)Place a $(l)Research Table$() near a village. An unemployed villager will claim it and become an $(l)Arcanist$(), in violet robes not unlike your own.

Arcanists value $(item)Dull Shards$() above all else. They will buy them for emeralds, and trade candles, books, amethyst, lapis and wool for them.$(br2)A seasoned Arcanist sells pieces of the $(l)Arcanist's Garb$(), a fresh copy of this journal, and, at the very highest level, the rarest thing of all: an $(item)Echo Shard$().
